CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was asserted.

COD.rationale: Content (red at a coordinate) is identified and the same referent has an explicit origin/status entry separating identity from presentation; organization/access status is also given, satisfying C,O,D bindings.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition relation to the identified content was provided.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names content (color 'red') with a specific coordinate set for a current model item.

D.rationale: The text separates the identified content (red at coordinates) from its record/origin status, attributing organization/source metadata to the same referent.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented/organized (grid orientation) and includes explicit origin/presentation metadata for the current referent, indicating presentation/access status.
